# Agora WUI

> Framework-agnostic React Teams UI for collaboration through an Agora Hub. On npm as `@abstractframework/agora-wui`; channel virtual file systems (vfs), @vfs references, missions, and direct native-Hub transport.

## Core Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, install, deployment boundary, thread-card interaction model, and channel vfs capabilities.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, embedding (direct or behind a host relay), browser authentication, and thread navigation.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): ownership, native-Hub topology, and the per-channel vfs flow (diagrams).
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): exported React and client API, including embedding options and the stylesheet/design-token contract.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): design and integration answers.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): connection and rendering recovery.

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and contribution boundaries.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting and credential handling.

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
- [ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md): Teams source lineage.
